before.title: NS0031 rational rank-19 marking obstruction
before.scope: No characteristic-zero K3 surface X/QQ with geometric Neron--Severi lattice NS0031 can have all nineteen divisor classes defined over QQ. The exact transcendental Gram [[0,0,4],[0,74,1],[4,1,-2]] has split even Clifford order whose norm-one group is Gamma_ns(4) intersect Gamma_0(37); direct coset enumeration gives index 304, elliptic counts (0,4), cusp widths (4,4,148,148), and genus 23. A full rational NS0031 marking would give a noncuspidal rational point on this curve and hence on X_0(37). By Velu's determination, the only two noncuspidal rational X_0(37) j-invariants are -7*11^3 and -7*137^3*2083^3. Both have good reduction at 19 with a_19=-6, so their mod-4 Frobenius trace-determinant pair is (2,3), which is absent from the full unramified non-split Cartan. Neither point, nor any quadratic twist, lifts. Consequently no rootless NS0031 fibration over QQ(t) can have a saturated rational MW17 basis. The formal ZZ_7 branch and geometric corridor remain valid, but cannot close the arithmetic milestone over QQ.
